about: Short drafts in and out of The Unreal Lab's voice (docs/business/the-unreal-lab.md section 6): composed, restrained, specific, decisive; no hype, swagger, filler or fictional characters. Written 2026-09-26 by the author; the owner's edits replace these as they arrive.
